'''Oyokal''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Oyokal system/Legends|Oyokal system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the world to the [[Shihon system/Legends|Shihon system]]. A [[Unidentified Oyokal species|quadrupedal species]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Oyokal.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the Chiss Ascendancy maintained Oyokal as an aquaculture [[Colonist/Legends|colony]]. The planet's surface featured [[Water/Legends|wave]]-riding [[Algae/Legends|algal]] beds and pools stocked with [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oyokal was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square E-8.<ref name="TEA" />
